visual.name: htmlContent
visual.description: Visualize column or measure values as HTML in your Power BI reports.

en-US.Landing_Body: Add a measure or field that returns HTML to the Values well in the Visualizations pane, and it renders right here - live on the canvas.
en-US.Landing_SandboxNote: Some browser features are limited inside Power BI's sandbox -
en-US.Landing_ChannelBadge_Alpha: ALPHA BUILD — NOT FOR PRODUCTION USE
en-US.Landing_ChannelBadge_Beta: BETA BUILD — NOT FOR PRODUCTION USE
en-US.Roles_Values_Description: Field values or measures containing the desired HTML data to render.
en-US.Roles_Sampling_Description: Use this to provide context for your data. Columns add row context, enabling grouping and interactivity (such as cross-filtering). Measures add context for report page tooltips or drillthrough pages.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_Behavior_Descr: Options to control the behavior of the rendered HTML.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_DefaultBodySty: Options to control the default styling of the rendered HTML body.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_Separation_Des: Options to separate multiple values in the rendered output.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_Format_Descrip: The renderer to apply to supplied content. HTML is the default, but you can also use Github Flavored Markdown. Note that detected HTML will be subject to the same sanitization rules if you are using using HTML Content Secure.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_RenderMode_Des: Controls how the visual updates the DOM when the underlying dataset (or a volatile property) changes. Rebuild content redraws everything on each update. Preserve unchanged content keeps entries whose value has not changed, so embedded content such as iframes does not reload.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_ShowRawHTML_De: Display the data as raw HTML, rather than rendered HTML.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_EnableDiagnost: Show a diagnostics icon (when editing in Power BI Desktop and Service only) that opens a dialog reporting what the sanitizer removed (if applicable), captured console output, and the raw rendered HTML.
en-US.Diagnostics_IconTitle: View diagnostic information (Ctrl + D | Cmd + D)
en-US.Diagnostics_IconAriaLabel: View diagnostic information (Ctrl + D | Cmd + D)
en-US.Diagnostics_SanitizerEmpty: No removals in the last render.
en-US.Diagnostics_RawBanner: This is the processed HTML, adjusted for output.
en-US.Diagnostics_RawBannerSanitized: This is the processed HTML, adjusted for output and sanitized.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_FontFamily_Des:

en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_OverrideInline:
Force the four properties above (font family, font size, font color, text alignment) to apply to every element in the rendered HTML, even those carrying inline 𝚜𝚝𝚢𝚕𝚎 attributes. Useful when content was pasted from Outlook, Teams, or Word and you want the visual's body styling to be authoritative.

When disabled (default), inline color, font, and alignment are honored as authored — recommended when your data emits intentional inline styles (e.g., conditional formatting via DAX).

en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_UserSelect_Des: If enabled, you can use the mouse to select text within the visual container. You can copy this to the clipboard with Ctrl + C, or your operating system's default.
en-US.Objects_ContentFormatting_NoDataMessage_: If your visual contains no data, you are able to specify the message that is displayed. You can assign this a measure containing HTML using conditional formatting, if you so wish.
en-US.Objects_Stylesheet_Description: Here you can use conditional formatting to apply valid CSS for the entire visual's stylesheet using a measure with the desired content.
en-US.Objects_Templates_Description: Wrap and compose your content with HTML templates. Use the {{content}} token in the body template to mark where rows go, and the {{row}} token in the row template to mark where each row's value goes.
en-US.Objects_Templates_BodyTemplate_Descripti: HTML wrapped around all rows. The {{content}} token marks where the rendered rows are inserted. Supports conditional formatting from a measure.
en-US.Objects_Templates_RowTemplate_Descriptio: HTML wrapped around each row. The {{row}} token marks where the row's value goes. Vary the content per row from your measure; set this to {{row}} when your measure already emits the row element (e.g. a <tr> for a table).
en-US.Objects_CrossFilter_Description: If enabled, this will invoke cross-filtering of other visuals, based on the Context of your dataset.
en-US.Objects_CrossFilter_Enabled_Description: Enable cross-filtering of other visuals, if Context is provided.
en-US.Objects_CrossFilter_UseTransparency_Desc: If enabled, this will set the use transparency to indicate non-selected items. Alternatively, you can manually set the styling of non-selected items by using the .𝚑𝚝𝚖𝚕𝚅𝚒𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚛𝙴𝚗𝚝𝚛𝚢.𝚞𝚗𝚜𝚎𝚕𝚎𝚌𝚝𝚎𝚍 CSS class in your stylesheet.
en-US.Objects_CrossFilter_TransparencyPercent_: The transparency percentage to apply to unselected items.
en-US.Objects_Compatibility_Description: Compatibility options for reports built with earlier versions of the visual.
en-US.Objects_Compatibility_LegacyRendering_De: Render content with the v1 styling rules and row structure. Turned on automatically for reports migrated from v1; off for new visuals.
